svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lid of the same stock box, with its four corner screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One hole for the light pipe, 3.2 mm. Mark it on the outside face:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 mm from the centre toward the right (CT gland) end and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm from the centre toward the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill at low speed with wood behind; deburr both faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the light pipe's datasheet: some need a 3.0 mm press-fit hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the light pipe pushes up through the hole from inside until

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its bezel sits on the lid's top face; a drop of silicone

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sealant under the bezel keeps the box IP54.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lid goes on last, its own gasket clean, with the box's four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws tightened evenly in a cross pattern.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the light pipe stands upright and lines up with the LED.
